Redrawn from JMI drawing OA/031, "VOX AC.15 amplifier circuit No. 3" (29-4-60) — layout DERIVED from that circuit drawing; JMI published no board-layout sheet for the AC15 and none was located — not a trace
T1 — Haddon OF 031 · HT secondary 300-0-300 V at 130 mA · 6.3 V, 4 A heater winding · primary taps 115/160/205/225/245 V
CH1 — Radiospares OA 123 · 10–20 H · 100 mA DC
T2 — Haddon OA 063 · push-pull EL84 primary · 8 Ω / 15 Ω secondary taps

Heater layer: no factory board-layout drawing exists for this amplifier, so its heater wiring cannot be read off one. At the centre-tapped valves (V2, V5, V6, V7) it shows the two heater pins on opposite supply legs — the 12.6 V series
arrangement; a 6.3 V supply straps them into one leg and returns on the centre tap. The valves on the chain are this circuit's own; the order the chain reaches them in is this drawing's convention.
Note: the 6.3 V heater twisted pair always routes on the top layer and never joins another run — its crossings are not hop-overs.
6.3 V heaters — twisted pair (leg grouping not established)
